preflight.planAuthority: Plan Maestro ERP V5 — Solqaryn — FUENTE RECTORA VAEP / N8.3 Navegadores

technicalSupportBasis.note: Angular CLI default browser compatibility follows the supported browser set for the installed Angular major when no local Browserslist override exists.

scope: Make browser-support contract explicit without broadening beyond Angular 20 support.
Add causal cross-browser E2E coverage for Chromium, Firefox and WebKit/Safari-engine behavior.
Keep backend, persistence, API, RBAC, deploy and production out of scope unless a browser defect proves causal.
outOfScope: Large functional rewrites unrelated to browser compatibility.
risks: Current E2E configuration does not define cross-browser projects.
Current causal N8.2 workflow installs Chromium only.
Engine-specific CSS/DOM behavior can remain undetected without Firefox/WebKit execution.
preflight.rollback: Revert only the browser-support contract/test/workflow changes introduced by N8.3; no data rollback is applicable.
preflight.testStrategy: Directed smoke/regression on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with lint/build preceding E2E; preserve existing device regression and avoid backend/migration gates when no such delta exists.
